edits.from: Count how many food packages were blue.
edits.to: Compare package appearance without checking what affected and unaffected people actually ate.

edits.from: Cold always sterilizes meat instantly.
edits.to: Chilling slows growth but by itself removes every microbe already present.

edits.from: Reading a page about beavers.
edits.to: Knowing that beavers can carry Giardia without a water-exposure pathway.

edits.from: Standing near any tree.
edits.to: Being outdoors without evidence of a contaminated water source.

edits.from: Are their bars the same colour?
edits.to: Compare bar colours without checking the legend, date or denominator.

edits.from: Which country name is shorter?
edits.to: Compare the place names rather than the rates and time periods.

edits.from: Whichever name is longer.
edits.to: Use the larger raw case count without adjusting for population size.

edits.from: The number of pages in the textbook.
edits.to: Use an undated number without checking how or when it was measured.

edits.from: It turns milk into a sterile metal.
edits.to: It makes milk completely sterile, so later storage and handling cannot matter.

edits.from: It adds a living vaccine to the milk.
edits.to: It protects milk by adding a vaccine rather than by controlled heat treatment.

edits.from: A vaccine injected into the surface.
edits.to: Use a skin antiseptic on an instrument without checking whether it can sterilize the instrument.

edits.from: Whether the cases have identical first names.
edits.to: Count repeated reports as separate cases without checking whether they describe the same person.

edits.from: Whether an old national chart has the same bar colour.
edits.to: Use an old national chart as the current local outbreak rate.

edits.from: Only landfills and water treatment.
edits.to: Only public sanitation, with no targeted response within the body.

edits.from: Growing new cilia after smoke exposure.
edits.to: Rebuilding a physical barrier rather than making a targeted immune response.

edits.from: An antibody is a kind of public-health advisory.
edits.to: An antibody is a population-level warning rather than a protein in an immune response.

edits.from: The donor and recipient have different first names.
edits.to: Family relationship matters more than antigen matching for red-cell compatibility.

edits.from: The red cells contain a cold virus.
edits.to: A respiratory virus is the key factor in ABO red-cell matching.

edits.from: Every symptom product is an antibiotic.
edits.to: A medicine that reduces symptoms also kills the organism causing them.

edits.from: Different brand names prove the ingredients differ.
edits.to: Different brand names guarantee the active ingredients cannot overlap.

edits.from: It teaches a person's cells to become viruses.
edits.to: It trains the immune response by causing the body to produce an infection indefinitely.

edits.from: A gene is a whole person.
edits.to: A visible chromosome shape directly reveals every gene on that chromosome.

edits.from: A Punnett square is a family photograph.
edits.to: The four boxes record four children who have already been born.

edits.from: Human eye colour has no genetic contribution.
edits.to: One allele pair is enough to predict every detail of human eye colour.

edits.from: A brighter chart colour.
edits.to: More precise-looking chart colours without stronger evidence.

edits.from: Timelines cannot show any event order.
edits.to: A timeline can identify a cause by itself, without testing the proposed pathway.

edits.from: Wait for the water to look different.
edits.to: Wait for visible cloudiness before taking a positive test result seriously.

edits.from: Red blood cells in a vein.
edits.to: A blood cell circulating nearby, without crossing the damaged barrier.

edits.from: Antibodies on a food surface.
edits.to: An antibody in the environment rather than a cell responding at the wound.

edits.from: All red tissue is a genetic disorder.
edits.to: Redness alone identifies a specific inherited disorder.

edits.from: Only a list of first names.
edits.to: Names alone, without symbols or relationship lines, are enough to show inheritance.
